cases.query: Analyze the trace for binder-related I/O blocking and explain the evidence-backed root cause.
goldenPoints: Identify the binder path and the blocking I/O interval from trace evidence.
Separate the observed wait from unsupported causal speculation.

cases.query: Analyze the framework pipeline execution and identify the stage that dominates latency.
goldenPoints: Reconstruct the pipeline stage order from trace evidence.
Attribute the dominant delay to a concrete stage and time range.

cases.query: Produce a general performance diagnosis while preserving evidence and identity contracts.
goldenPoints: State only conclusions supported by trace evidence.
Preserve process and thread identity when describing findings.

cases.query: Analyze GPU workload timing and determine whether GPU execution is the primary bottleneck.
goldenPoints: Quantify relevant GPU work intervals.
Distinguish GPU saturation from CPU-side submission delay.

cases.query: Trace the input interaction path and explain the main contributor to end-to-end latency.
goldenPoints: Anchor the interaction start and visible response in the trace.
Identify the largest latency segment without conflating adjacent work.

cases.query: Analyze Linux system state and explain the most important scheduling or resource constraint.
goldenPoints: Use system-state evidence to identify the constrained resource.
Relate scheduling state to the affected workload with correct identities.

cases.query: Analyze the media, network, and camera pipeline and identify the evidence-backed bottleneck.
goldenPoints: Reconstruct the relevant cross-component media path.
Attribute delay to a measured component rather than temporal proximity alone.

cases.query: Analyze memory and garbage-collection pressure and explain its performance impact.
goldenPoints: Quantify garbage-collection or allocation pressure from trace evidence.
Connect pauses to workload impact without overstating causality.

cases.query: Analyze power and thermal behavior and determine whether throttling affects the workload.
goldenPoints: Identify thermal or frequency changes in the relevant time window.
Distinguish correlation from evidence of throttling impact.

cases.query: Analyze rendering jank and identify the dominant cause of missed frames.
goldenPoints: Quantify missed or delayed frames in the interaction window.
Attribute jank to a concrete CPU, GPU, or scheduling interval.

cases.query: Analyze scheduler and CPU contention and identify the workload most responsible for delay.
goldenPoints: Quantify runnable or blocked time for the affected thread.
Resolve the competing process or thread identity from evidence.

cases.query: Diagnose the startup mechanism, separate trace facts from source explanation, and identify the exact source location, call chain, and actionable seam.
goldenPoints: Treat the trace marker occurrence and duration as trace-authoritative facts; a CodeRef alone cannot prove that the event occurred.
Identify StartupHooks.initializeOnMainThread in StartupHooks.kt with the exact generated line and call chain.
Map the trace marker to the source mechanism and recommend the bounded post-first-frame seam without exposing raw source text.

cases.query: Analyze application startup and explain the dominant lifecycle bottleneck.
goldenPoints: Bound the startup interval with trace evidence.
Identify the lifecycle stage that contributes the largest measured delay.
